headline: Strange Academy Movie Rumored Details Emerge
post:
Hey Marvel fans! According to a report, Strange Academy is reportedly being looked at for a feature-length film in the MCU rather than a Disney+ series.

Scooper James Mack claims a casting call is out for lead characters Emily Bright and Doyle Dormammu. The report indicates Marvel Studios is reportedly seeking an actress to play Doyle, which would make the character female instead of male like in the comics.

headline: Ted Evans talks Retreat and BAFTA Breakthrough
post:
Have you heard about the genre-bending thriller making waves? According to The Hollywood Reporter, writer-director Ted Evans was recently named to the 2026 U.K. BAFTA Breakthrough list, supported by Netflix. 🎬

Evans directed the film "Retreat", which has been billed as “the world’s first deaf thriller.” The project follows a young woman arriving at a remote wellness retreat, and the filmmaker spent a decade developing the feature after working on an earlier short film of the same name. 

Speaking about the creative process, Evans shared how working with visual language shaped his approach to filmmaking, noting that sign language requires careful attention to rhythm and continuity. 

What is your favorite thriller of the year?

#TedEvans #Retreat #BAFTABreakthrough
original_title: BAFTA Breakthrough Ted Evans Shares What Sign Language Taught Him About Film – and What’s Next After ‘Retreat’

headline: Clayface knocked down by Elizabeth Holmes doc
post:
The box office has a brand new king for the holiday weekend! Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s Elizabeth Holmes documentary, You Can See Everything, claimed the No. 1 spot with $11.4 million. 

That impressive run managed to knock DC's body-horror villain movie Clayface down to No. 2 with $11 million during its second weekend in theaters.

Which of these two theatrical releases have you seen on the big screen yet?

#BoxOffice #Clayface #DCU
original_title: Clayface Just Lost the Box Office to 2026’s Biggest Surprise Hit & It’s A Game-Changing Moment For Movies

headline: Mason Thames cast as Dick Grayson
post:
Hey superhero fans! DC Studios has officially cast Mason Thames as the voice of Dick Grayson in the upcoming animated film "Dynamic Duo", according to /Film. 🎬

According to DC Studios co-head Peter Safran, Thames was "obsessed" with landing the part and "auditioned the s*** out of it." The actor joins Logan Kim, who is playing Jason Todd in the project from Swaybox Studios. Arthur Mintz is directing the movie, which will combine puppetry and CGI for a stop-motion effect.

While previous comments from James Gunn suggested actors would play their characters across multiple mediums, it remains unconfirmed if Thames will step into the live-action role.

Are you excited for "Dynamic Duo"? 

#DynamicDuo #DCStudios #MasonThames
original_title: DC Studios Officially Casts Mason Thames As Robin — Will He Play Him In Live-Action?
